Zip archival format, ported from zip.go.

Backend is our own zipfile (local headers, central directory, EOCD parsed/written directly; store or deflate via our own flate). Symlink targets are stored as file content with symlink mode bits, like Go. No seekable-stream requirement: entries parse from memory.
